title: Replay FSCrawler ordinary DOCX across the BUMP POI upgrade
description: Use the two original FSCrawler commits and their own archived Maven dependencies on Alpine OpenJDK 11.0.19+7 and Maven 3.9.2. Run the unmodified named testExtractFromDocx and testExtractFromTxt tests inside a networkless unprivileged namespace. Capture exact named test counts, errors, the application content observed through TikaDocParser.generate and the independently loaded extractor on each ordered runtime classpath. The separate nonordinary file reported by the original CI is excluded from rerun.
expected: Both revisions report actual named outcomes or their first unexecuted build boundary. The normal DOCX and plain-text companion are independently observed when the original test classpath is materialized.

resources.notes: The historical full breaking build took 2m53s. This paired offline job selects two named tests through the original Maven reactor, with four bounded JVM test runs.

steps.name: Replay original FSCrawler tests and caller fields on the historical runtime
